verdict.rationale: The only evidence of operating across many items is a one-line Document QnA mention of "multi-document queries and comparisons" (docs-13), plus official Python/TypeScript SDKs (docs-28) that would let users script their own loops. A hands-on report says a 900-page job timed out and had to be split into smaller chunks (comm-4), which limits large single-shot jobs. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk processing API or async job endpoint, bulk annotation/extraction across many documents in one call, documented volume limits or concurrency guidance, and independent corroboration of reliable large-scale bulk runs.
